intro: HITAM and SCIS, University of Hyderabad both sit in Hyderabad, and this page compares their recorded M.Tech / M.E. fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in 2026.

HITAM vs SCIS, University of Hyderabad is not a single winner. HITAM is recorded as a private institute, while SCIS, University of Hyderabad is public. Pick the campus that matches the programme you want, the fee you can pay, and the admission test you will take.

sections.heading: HITAM vs SCIS, University of Hyderabad for M.Tech / M.E.: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose SCIS, University of Hyderabad if you want a public M.Tech / M.E. option and the admission route and fees that usually come with a government or state university campus.
Choose HITAM if a private campus, its specific specialisation or its recorded placement year fits your plan better, after you have checked the official fee notice.
HITAM lists M.Tech. SCIS, University of Hyderabad lists M.Tech Artificial Intelligence, M.Tech Computer Science & Engineering, M.Tech Information Technology.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip application, hostel-only or short-course rows so a registration fee is not treated as tuition.
Our records list ₹1.64 lakh a year as tuition fees for HITAM's M.Tech. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.

Our records list ₹59,833 a year as tuition fees for SCIS, University of Hyderabad's M.Tech Artificial Intelligence. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.
If fees are your only filter, confirm the current official circular for the exact programme and batch you will join, because year figures and older rows can understate the real cost.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: In our records, HITAM's 2023 figures are an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹11 lakh for M.Tech. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.

In our records, SCIS, University of Hyderabad's 2024 figures include a highest package of ₹46 lakh for M.Tech Computer Science & Engineering. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.
The recorded years are 2023 and 2024, so the two packages should not be read as a head-to-head for the same graduating class.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: HITAM's recorded admission tests on this page include GATE.
SCIS, University of Hyderabad's recorded admission tests on this page include GATE.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Hyderabad, Andhra Pradesh. The choice is less about moving city and more about the programme, fees and admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read the official hostel and location notes, before you accept an offer.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want the stronger recorded public standing or NIRF rank in this pair, SCIS, University of Hyderabad is the safer first pick, after you have checked official fees and seats.
HITAM can still be the better fit if its specialisation, city or recorded fee level matches what you can join this year.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.
